note: BH-8186: a head Mergify dequeued for a failed batch (MC_FAILED_BATCH_CODES) is recorded against its patch-id under state/merge-conductor/failed-batch/, and a READY head that carries the same patch (verbatim patch-id, or mc_patch_same's clean-main-merge proof) is not enqueued until a new patch, a solo re-run that passes, or MC_FAILED_BATCH_UNJUDGED_HOLD_S. 0 = off: no record is written or read, and a rebased head is enqueued as before. Settings row: lane.merge-conductor.mc_failed_batch.
